plan.analysis: Inclusion is the failing class (recall 0.20, 148/179 missed): misses are tiny (median 34.7px vs 90.5px train), faint, thin vertical streaks; low-size tertile recall is 0.075 and nearly all misses are low-contrast. Patches (recall 0.61) and scratches (recall 0.54) both lose mainly on the small/low-contrast tertile (0.47 and 0.40 recall), with missed medians 51px and 41.6px. So all three classes need small, low-contrast synthetic examples; inclusion needs the biggest share. Corrected the invalid inclusion source 287 to the valid 297.
plan.rationale: Inclusion gets 25 images from the faint/thin vertical streak sources (11, 150, 297, 50, 268, 277) scaled to 0.3-0.8x to hit the ~35px missed size band, since the detector almost never sees small low-contrast inclusions. Patches (15) use prefer_small over all blob sources at 0.4-0.9x to produce ~35-75px low-contrast blobs matching the 51px missed median. Scratches (10) use prefer_small at 0.3-0.7x to shorten the long bright lines into the short thin ~40px strokes that are being missed. All classes stay well under the 80-image diminishing-return zone and above the 10-image floor, and same-class backgrounds keep paste texture realistic.
